entities.name: Twelve Tribes of Israel
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The tribal confederation that coalesced into the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. Organized by descent from the twelve sons of Jacob, each tribe held distinct territory. United under Saul, David, and Solomon before splitting into northern and southern kingdoms.
